changelog: **Cleaner rows.** Every list row now shares one right-to-left layout helper, so titles, tags like Demo, and mark-done circles no longer overlap. **Mini tracker player card.** The always-open tracker now starts with your portrait, name, role (tap to cycle the roles your class can play), and status pills that match the Guild tab. **No empty tips popup.** Tapping a dungeon tile on Next opens the Path tab only.
